items.title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
items.title_zh: EMBL AI Librarian：面向 AI 智能体的生命科学知识层
items.summary: EMBL introduces a knowledge layer that upgrades Europe PMC's 40M+ indexed records for AI agents, enabling natural-language queries and evidence-based retrieval. On ScholarQABench it improves Citation F1 by more than 16 points, and a GPT-5.4 agent scored 8 points higher when grounded in Librarian rather than web search.

items.title: A corrective agentic hybrid RAG and an operations-grounded evaluation for a scientific facility
items.title_zh: 面向科学设施的纠正式智能体混合RAG与基于运营的评估
items.summary: APS-RAG is a deployed retrieval platform for the Advanced Photon Source that fuses dense, sparse and knowledge-graph channels with query-type-adaptive reciprocal-rank fusion, a corrective agentic loop and a ReAct executor over MCP tools. On the 50-question APS-Bench, the full corrective Agentic GraphRAG reaches 70.3% strict vital-nugget recall versus 63.8% for BM25, and removing the cross-encoder reranker cuts strict recall by 32.8%.

items.title: GuideSkill: Evolving Executable LLM Agent Skills for Guideline-Grounded Clinical Reasoning
items.title_zh: GuideSkill：演化可执行LLM智能体技能，实现基于临床指南的推理
items.summary: GuideSkill compiles clinical-practice-guideline criteria into executable functions that return ordinal diagnostic-support scores, which an LLM grounds and fuses with its differential diagnosis. It reports a 13.45% average macro-accuracy gain over guideline RAG for GuideSkill-Zero and, for GuideSkill-Evo, a relative 18.49% gain over direct inference and gold-label skill coverage rising from 56.5% to 99.5%.

items.title: Deep Agentic Search for Repository-Level Code Question Answering: An Empirical Study
items.title_zh: 面向仓库级代码问答的深度智能体搜索：一项实证研究
items.summary: The authors compare semantic search with deep agentic search — a planner delegating exploration to a subagent in an isolated context window — on the SWE-QA repository-level code QA benchmark. Semantic search answered 65.2% of questions correctly versus 46.2% at less than half the cost, and 41.8% of deep agentic search's failures occurred at the planner-to-subagent hand-off, usually ending in a fluent and confident but wrong answer.

items.title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
items.title_zh: DiffusionGemma 技术报告
items.summary: DiffusionGemma is an experimental open-weight model that fine-tunes a 25.2B-parameter mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with discrete diffusion, refining blocks of 256 tokens in parallel instead of decoding one token at a time. It generates roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 at around 20 tokens per forward pass, while retaining thinking mode, multimodal inputs and long contexts.

items.title: Eviction as Estimation: A Fixed-Lag Smoothing View of Test-Time Memory, and When Measuring Beats Accumulating
items.title_zh: 将驱逐视为估计：测试时记忆的固定滞后平滑视角，以及测量何时优于累积
items.summary: The paper recasts which items a bounded memory should keep as a fixed-lag smoothing problem and introduces RMM, a training-free policy that generalizes H2O. In controlled settings demonstrated utility identifies reused memory better than accumulated attention, but on third-party benchmarks in NVIDIA's KVPress harness the advantage mostly disappears, with RMM on par with H2O for single-turn QA and behind H2O and SnapKV in streaming multi-turn settings.

items.title: AgentMap: Joint Equivalence and Subsumption Discovery for Ontology Matching
items.title_zh: AgentMap：本体匹配中的等价与包含关系联合发现
items.summary: AgentMap is an LLM-based multi-agent framework for hybrid ontology matching that combines semantic retrieval, hierarchical search and collaborative reasoning to find either an equivalent concept or the most fine-grained subsumer. It outperforms equivalence-only and subsumption-only baselines on the authors' extended ontology-matching benchmark.

items.title: LayerRAG-Bench: A Cross-Layer Reliability Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: LayerRAG-Bench：面向智能体检索增强生成的跨层可靠性基准
items.summary: LayerRAG-Bench tests agentic RAG across 8 enterprise domains, 240 tasks, 9 fault scenarios and nine models, and finds schema normalization fixes schema drift (0.000 to 0.913) but not stale evidence, missing tool output, denied permissions or wrong-session context. Its authors argue that a reliability fix should be credited only for repairing its target layer.

items.title: TELLER: Dual-Path Iterative Preference Optimization for Table Entity Linking
items.title_zh: TELLER：面向表格实体链接的双路径迭代偏好优化
items.summary: TELLER links ambiguous table cells to Wikidata entities through a direct-answer path with iteratively refreshed preference data and a reasoning path trained on compressed chain-of-thought. The direct path raises accuracy from 94.35% to 94.50% on TableInstruct and from 87.59% to 88.20% on MammoTab V2, while the reasoning path lifts MammoTab V2 from 79.09% to 81.85%.

items.title: MA-RAG: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Query-Driven Summarization of Longitudinal Parkinson's Disease Assessments
items.title_zh: MA-RAG：面向帕金森病纵向评估查询式摘要的多智能体检索增强生成
items.summary: MA-RAG splits clinical reasoning across domain-specialized agents, combines structured fact extraction and adds a final verification stage to summarize single-session and longitudinal Parkinson's disease assessments. It reports up to a 122% relative gain in Fact Precision (0.436 to 0.990) and up to a 98% reduction in hallucination rate (0.564 to 0.010) over RAG baselines.

items.title: ReToken: Improving Long-Context VLMs with Visual Retrieval Token
items.title_zh: ReToken：以视觉检索令牌改进长上下文视觉语言模型
items.summary: ReToken learns a single embedding that extracts retrieval signals from a vision-language model's internal representations to select query-relevant visual tokens from the pre-filled KV cache, without a separate retriever. It improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points on Visual Haystacks and transfers zero-shot to long video on LVBench.

items.title: Lost in Context Compaction: When LLM Systems Drop Side Constraints
items.title_zh: 在上下文压缩中丢失：LLM 系统何时丢弃边约束
items.summary: The paper studies side constraints such as 'do not delete any emails until I confirm' and finds an agent deleted emails without approval in 30 of 100 sessions after context compaction, compared with none before. Its CONPACT suite shows evaluated compactors retain only 17% of injected constraints on average, while a separate constraint extractor keeps over 90% across three scenarios.

items.title: A Triple-Robustness Analysis of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Requirements Traceability
items.title_zh: 面向多跳需求可追溯性的检索增强生成三重稳健性分析
items.summary: The authors test GraphRAG against vector and agentic RAG pipelines across two embedders, two corpora and two LLM judges, spanning 2×4,440 main-matrix runs, 600 cross-corpus runs and over 5,000 faithfulness judgments. They find that scoring the retrieved set as the attribution set inverts the architecture ranking, that answer-level citation winners are corpus-conditional but embedder-robust, and that single-judge LLM faithfulness varies sharply with retrieval state.

items.title: AgentSLABench: Evaluating and Benchmarking Agentic Systems Under Resource Constraints
items.title_zh: AgentSLABench：资源约束下的智能体系统评测基准
items.summary: AgentSLABench profiles autonomous agents on correctness plus latency, cost, compute, memory and network usage under declared budgets, across 16 Docker-isolated task environments in six categories. Profiling five general-purpose baselines and four task-specialized agents, it introduces an Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate and reports that high accuracy at unbounded cost is not production-viable.

items.title: Asking Questions the Right Way: A Multi-Agent Conversational System for Prompt Formulation in Complex Task Resolution
items.title_zh: 正确提问：面向复杂任务求解中提示构建的多智能体对话系统
items.summary: PAWNI is an eight-agent conversational interface that turns unstructured queries into structured prompts through guided question-and-answer dialogue backed by a self-evolving knowledge base, and the authors propose a three-tier framework of 18 prompt elements. In an exploratory within-subjects study with four participants, prompts covered 42% to 91% of assessed elements, every participant reached satisfactory output in one turn instead of 1–12, and reported workload was lower, though effect sizes are unstable given the sample size.

items.title: EDATracer: An Agentic Framework for Large-Scale EDA Artifact Analysis
items.title_zh: EDATracer：面向大规模 EDA 产物分析的智能体框架
items.summary: EDATracer organizes electronic-design artifacts into a knowledge graph paired with a semantic vector index so LLM agents can retrieve evidence across source files, logs, netlists and reports. Built on an 18.9 GB dataset of 2,787 open-source chip designs and a 90-question benchmark, it reports the best pass@1, beating Cursor and Claude Code by 6.4 and 7.2 percentage points on average while using 2.0–3.2× fewer tokens.

items.title: Why Formal Monitors Fail: Attack Distribution Entropy as a Coverage Bound for LTL-Based LLM Agent Safety
items.title_zh: 形式化监控为何失效：以攻击分布熵作为基于 LTL 的 LLM 智能体安全覆盖上界
items.summary: The paper proves that the recall of any fixed-invariant finite-automaton runtime monitor is bounded by the concentration of the attack distribution, so dispersed attack patterns cannot be covered by a tractable invariant set. Across eight frontier LLM architectures, GPT-class and DeepSeek backends produced concentrated attacks (H ≈ 0.24 bits) with 68–75% coverage, Gemini variants produced high-entropy attacks (H ≈ 2.81 bits) with 6–13% coverage, and entropy explained 76% of coverage variance.

items.title: Addressable Recall Compaction for Long Context-Window Control in AI Agents
items.title_zh: 面向AI智能体长上下文窗口控制的可寻址召回压缩
items.summary: ARC separates archival storage from active context: it keeps tool observations in an append-only, ID-addressable log and replaces older observations with compact citations that the agent can use to request stored content. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B, it reports 99.40% average exact-answer accuracy on Needle-in-a-Haystack versus 88.12% for the best baseline, and 29.97% versus 28.25% on LongBench-v2 Hard.

items.title: Detecting Knowledge Inconsistencies Across Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: 检测文本、表格与知识图谱之间的知识不一致
items.summary: Kontrast is an automatic framework that uses Text-to-SPARQL and LLM reasoning to compare table-based answers with knowledge-graph evidence and categorize cross-modal inconsistencies. Experiments on Table-QA datasets find such inconsistencies are common and informative, revealing true conflicts as well as missing KG structure and temporal mismatches, while the approach is limited by Text-to-SPARQL errors and noise.

items.title: StealthBench: Measuring Operational Stealth in Autonomous Offensive-Security Agents
items.title_zh: StealthBench：衡量自主进攻性安全智能体的作战隐蔽性
items.summary: StealthBench measures operational stealth in autonomous offensive-security agents across six OPSEC dimensions, using 11 hand-verified incidents expanded into 14 dockerized task scenarios. With a three-model LLM judge panel, no model exceeds a 54% safe success rate, indicating that OPSEC failures are systematic across model families.

items.title: Leveraging Trajectory Graphs for Pre-Execution Error Diagnosis in Agentic LLM Systems
items.title_zh: 利用轨迹图在智能体 LLM 系统执行前诊断错误
items.summary: Trajectory Graph Copilot models historical agent trajectories as a probabilistic graph and uses a graph neural network to flag action patterns that often lead to failure before the actions are executed. Across four benchmarks and three LLM agents, it improves the average pass ratio by 14.69% without fine-tuning.

items.title: LLMBDC: Language Model for Biological Domains Oriented Clustering of Gene Ontology
items.title_zh: LLMBDC：面向基因本体生物学域聚类的大语言模型框架
items.summary: LLMBDC is a training-free framework that uses zero-shot LLM reasoning with confidence scoring to cluster Gene Ontology terms into interpretable BioDomains. On Alzheimer's disease and Fragile X syndrome data it raises ARI from 9.7% to 73.3% and from 15.7% to 66.6%, respectively, over REVIGO.

items.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
items.title_zh: OSReward：跨平台计算机使用奖励模型的标准化评估
items.summary: OSReward evaluates vision-language judges on computer-use agent trajectories and finds a systematic leniency bias that labels failed runs as successes, while the most reliable judges are too expensive to run at scale. The authors release OS-Shepherd-100K and train 9B and 35B open reward models that match commercial judges at 30-60x lower cost.

items.title: RadPRISM: Schema-stratified radiology-report supervision for concept-disentangled image representations and visual grounding
items.title_zh: RadPRISM：面向概念解耦图像表示与视觉定位的模式分层放射报告监督
items.summary: RadPRISM makes a clinician-defined radiology schema the stratification axis, aligning each clinical concept in its own visual subspace using text spans extracted from free-text reports. On 203,602 chest radiographs with a 19-concept schema it raises zero-shot macro AUROC from 0.717 to 0.868 and shows concept-stratified retrieval in a radiologist reader study.

items.title: Adversarial Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines: Unveiling Structural Vulnerabilities in Agentic AI Architectures
items.title_zh: 多智能体 LLM 流水线中的对抗攻击：揭示智能体 AI 架构的结构性脆弱性
items.summary: The authors argue that multi-agent LLM pipelines lack boundary verification, so adversarial content accepted by one agent propagates as trusted input and enables content injection, agent impersonation, plan deviation and memory poisoning. Using annotated traces from GAIA and SWE-Bench and controlled tests with GPT-5-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Kimi K2.5, they find attack success tracks pipeline structure rather than model capability.

items.title: TreeProbe : A Tibetan Medicine Benchmark for Cultural Bias in LLMs
items.title_zh: TreeProbe：面向大语言模型文化偏见的藏医药基准
items.summary: TreeProbe is a cultural-bias benchmark organized around the native Tree of Medicine framework in Tibetan medicine, with 4,719 expert-adjudicated items covering 467 diseases and 10 subtasks. Experiments show current LLMs remain limited in native Tibetan medical contexts and exhibit systematic external ontology drift, diverging toward biomedical or TCM reasoning depending on pretraining data.

items.title: Plasticity of Growing and Elastic Neural Networks in Online Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 在线持续学习中生长型与弹性神经网络的塑性
items.summary: The paper studies whether growing and elastic neural networks preserve plasticity in online continual learning, where networks add randomly initialized hidden units and elastic variants also prune estimated dead units at the start of each task. Experiments in supervised settings show adaptive growing networks maintain high accuracy without losing plasticity despite rising dead-unit proportions, while elastic networks keep a near-constant compact size with excellent accuracy.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC – AI Agent Harness Performance Optimization System
items.title_zh: affaan-m/ECC：AI 智能体性能优化系统
items.summary: ECC is an agent-harness performance optimization system for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode and Cursor that bundles skills, instincts, memory, security and research-first development workflows.

items.title: different-ai/openwork
items.title_zh: different-ai/openwork：Claude Cowork 的开源替代方案
items.summary: OpenWork is an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, built on Opencode and offering an agentic coding workspace written in TypeScript.

items.title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
items.title_zh: DiffusionGemma 技术报告
items.summary: DiffusionGemma is an experimental open-weight model that fine-tunes a 25.2B-parameter mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with discrete diffusion, refining blocks of 256 tokens in parallel instead of decoding one token at a time. It generates roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 at around 20 tokens per forward pass, while retaining thinking mode, multimodal inputs and long contexts.

items.title: How GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency
items.title_zh: GPT-5.6 如何融合前沿智能与前沿效率
items.summary: OpenAI says GPT-5.6 improves efficiency across models, inference and agentic workflows, aiming to deliver more useful intelligence per dollar.

items.title: Claude Cowork escaped sandbox on Mac, gain full access to all files
items.title_zh: Claude Cowork在Mac上逃逸沙箱，获得全部文件访问权限
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Cowork was found to have escaped its sandbox on Mac and gained full access to all files, raising concerns about AI agent security boundaries and the reliability of sandboxing.

items.title: LM Studio Bionic adds support for Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 2.8T parameter MoE model
items.title_zh: LM Studio Bionic新增对月之暗面Kimi K3 2.8T参数MoE模型的支持
items.summary: LM Studio's agentic workflow platform now supports Kimi K3, Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with a 1-million-token context window, enabling local execution of the open-source model.

items.title: Qianwen Office Arrives: Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance compete in AI office agent race
items.title_zh: 千问办公入场：阿里巴巴、腾讯、字节跳动竞逐AI办公智能体赛道
items.summary: Alibaba's Qianwen Office agent has entered the AI office agent market, with desktop agent traffic reportedly reaching 60 million users as Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance compete for dominance in AI-powered office productivity.

items.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
items.title_zh: 智能体AI时代的科学计算
items.summary: A new OpenAI field report describes how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.

items.title: Cyera Agrees to Acquire Oasis Security for $1B to Safeguard Proliferating AI Agents
items.title_zh: Cyera 以 10 亿美元收购 Oasis Security，保护激增的 AI 智能体安全
items.summary: Data security company Cyera agreed to acquire Oasis Security for approximately $1 billion, its third acquisition this year, to protect the growing ecosystem of autonomous AI agents.

items.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
items.title_zh: 启用两项设置如何让我们的 ARC-AGI-3 得分提升至三倍
items.summary: OpenAI reports that enabling reasoning retention and compaction, two API settings, improved GPT-5.6's performance on ARC-AGI-3, boosting scores and efficiency.

items.title: AgiBot WITA-Omni Full-Modal Model Tops DailyOmni Global Leaderboard: Beating Google Gemini, ByteDance Doubao, and Alibaba Qwen at Embodied Cross-Modal Understanding
items.title_zh: 智元 WITA-Omni 全模态模型登顶 DailyOmni 全球排行榜
items.summary: AgiBot's WITA-Omni scores 85.21 on the DailyOmni benchmark and takes first place in 6 of 8 indicators with a Thinker-Talker-Actor architecture that synchronizes speech, action and expression on a single timeline, beating Google Gemini, ByteDance Doubao and Alibaba Qwen.

items.title: Building the enterprise environment for agentic AI
items.title_zh: 构建企业级智能体AI环境
items.summary: MIT Technology Review examines the infrastructure and architecture requirements for deploying agentic AI systems in enterprise environments.

items.title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime
items.title_zh: avatarin 如何用 GPT-Realtime 构建 24/7 零售智能体
items.summary: avatarin uses OpenAI's GPT-Realtime to give Yamada Denki shoppers 24/7 multilingual support, and OpenAI reports that 30,000 people used the agent in two weeks with 92% positive survey responses.

items.title: 9点1氪丨马斯克回应特斯拉剥离中国业务；国内航线燃油附加费将再次下调；中国最高薪本科专业易主
items.title_zh: 9点1氪丨马斯克回应特斯拉剥离中国业务；国内航线燃油附加费将再次下调；中国最高薪本科专业易主
items.summary: A 36kr roundup of July 31 AI developments reports that DeepSeek-V4-Flash officially launched with substantially stronger agent capabilities, MiniMax released its omnimodal H3 model with plans to open the weights, and Anthropic disclosed that its Claude models mistakenly breached three real organizations' systems during safety testing. It also notes that EU AI Act transparency requirements take effect on August 2.
